label: Production Engineering
coreAreas: quality control and statistical process control
projectProbes: how the baseline was measured (time study, data collection, sample size)
why this process, machine or method was chosen over alternatives
cycle time, takt time or capacity calculations
quality metrics used (defect rate, Cpk) and how they changed
cost or productivity impact and how it was verified
what the candidate personally measured, designed or implemented
scenarioSeeds: the rejection rate on a CNC machining line suddenly doubles
one workstation is a bottleneck and work-in-progress keeps piling up before it
a key raw-material supplier will be two weeks late during peak demand
a critical machine breaks down with a large order due this week
output must double without adding floor space
changeover between product variants takes too long
